getMenu.text:
select rtrim(id) as id, rtrim(id0) as id0, case when '@@lan' = 'v' then text else text2 end as text, sysid, controller, xtype, vouchercode, img_code, img_pos, img_file, [disabled], mobile_yn, 0 as haschild, cast(0 as int) as level , link into #t from sysmenu where os like '%' + @os + '%' and (@@admin = 1 or id in (select menu_id from sysrightmenu where a_view = 1 and user_id = @@userId)) and status = 1 update #t set haschild = 1 from #t a where exists(select 1 from #t b where a.id = b.id0)
if @@admin <> 1 insert into #t(id, id0, text, haschild, sysid, controller,xtype,vouchercode,img_code,img_pos,img_file, disabled,mobile_yn, level) select id, id0, text, 0, 0, '', '', '', 0, '', '', 0, 1, 0 from sysmenu where rtrim(text) = '-' and vouchercode in (select id from #t)
select * from #t order by id drop table #t
select unit_id, ma_unit, case when '@@lan' = 'v' then ten_unit else ten_unit2 end as ten_unit from sysunit where unit_id = @@unit

bookmark.text: select a.user_id, a.menu_id, case when @lan = 'v' then b.text else b.text2 end as text from bookmark a join sysmenu b on a.menu_id = b.id and a.user_id = @@userId

bookmarkInsert.text: insert into bookmark(user_id, menu_id) select @@userId, @menuid where not exists(select 1 from bookmark where user_id = @@userId and menu_id = @menuid) select 1 as value

bookmarkDelete.text: delete bookmark where user_id = @@userId and menu_id = @menuid select 1 as value
